अजीगर्त

AJĪGARTA (ṛcīka) . He was a greedy Brahmin. (See

अजिन

AJINA . 1) Genealogy From viṣṇu, brahmā, marīci, kaśyapa, Vaivasvata, uttānapāda, dhruva, Śṛṣṭi, ripu, cākṣuṣa, manu, Uru, Aṁga, vena, pṛthu, antardhāna, havirdhāna and ajina.2) Birth. pṛthu had two sons, antardhāna and Vādi. antardhāna had a son, havirdhāna, by śikhaṇḍinī. dhiṣaṇā, who was born in the Agnikula became Havirdhāna's wife. Six sons were born to them, prācīnabarhis, śukra, gaya, kṛṣṇa, vraja and ajina. (viṣṇu purāṇa, Part I, Chapter 14).
